about: The author's chapters (the vault's LaTeX/compiled) as they were on 2026-10-25, identified by the xxh3-64 (tests/wordcount.rs) and sha256 (zotsearch/tests/test_wordcount.py) of each .tex, with the Lua counter's counts from a build of exactly those files and the counts expected here. Only a chapter whose file still has that hash is checked (tests/wordcount.rs, real_chapters).

5-methodology.tex.why: "final-epoch" was hyphenated across the break after PDF page 21 of that build, and the Lua counter counted each page's part as a word; it is one word by the counter's own rule (a word hyphenated across lines counts once)
